record.original_question: For the rewrite system encoding the Battle of Hydra and Hercules, which is terminating but not provably terminating in Peano Arithmetic, must every termination ordering that proves its termination have the Howard ordinal as its order type?

evidence.quote: Must any termination ordering used for proving termination of the Battle of Hydra and Hercules-system have the Howard ordinal as its order type?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the term rewriting system that encodes the Battle of Hydra and Hercules: hydras are finite rooted trees, Hercules' moves correspond to rewrite rules that delete a leaf and (if the leaf is not adjacent to the root) duplicate a chosen subtree above the leaf's grandparent some number of times, and the system is known to be terminating but not provably terminating in Peano Arithmetic. Recall that a termination ordering proving termination of a rewrite system is a well-founded strict order on terms, compatible with the rewrite relation, and its order type is the ordinal obtained by collapsing the induced well-founded relation on reachable terms. The Howard–Bachmann ordinal is the proof-theoretic ordinal of the theory ID_1 of one inductive definition.

Question: Must every termination ordering that proves termination of this Hydra–Hercules rewrite system have order type at least the Howard–Bachmann (Howard) ordinal?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work on Hydra battles and AC termination (Hirokawa and others, 2023) reports a reduction order compatible with the Hydra rewrite system whose order type is at most ε₀, the proof-theoretic ordinal of Peano Arithmetic. This negatively answers the question: the Howard–Bachmann ordinal is not required as the order type of every termination ordering for the Hydra system.

status_evidence.title: Hydra Battles and AC Termination
status_evidence.snippet: A reduction order compatible with the Hydra battle whose order type is at most ε₀ is exhibited, showing that the Howard–Bachmann ordinal is not necessary.
status_evidence.claim: A termination ordering with order type ≤ ε₀ proving termination of the Hydra system exists, so the Howard ordinal is not required.

status_evidence.title: Hydra Battles and AC Termination (FSCD 2023)
status_evidence.snippet: We answer Cichon's question by constructing a termination order for the Hydra system with order type below the Howard-Bachmann ordinal.
status_evidence.claim: Cichon's question on whether termination orders for the Hydra battle must have Howard-Bachmann order type is answered negatively.
